title: dryopteris filix-mas subsp. pseudorigida
intro: Dryopteris filix-mas subsp. pseudorigida, commonly known as the stiff-leaved male fern, is a subspecies of fern that belongs to the Dryopteris genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, wounds, and other conditions. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris filix-mas subsp. pseudorigida include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
